question_vi: Core Web Vitals và Next.js tối ưu chúng như thế nào?
question_en: What are Core Web Vitals and how does Next.js optimize them?
answer_vi: Next.js tối ưu: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) qua image optimization, priority images; CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) qua next/image với dimensions, next/font với size-adjust; INP (Interaction to Next Paint, thay FID từ 3/2024) qua code splitting, lazy loading, Concurrent Mode. Dùng `@vercel/analytics` (không phải `next/analytics`) để báo cáo Core Web Vitals production.
answer_en: Next.js optimizes: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) via image optimization and the priority prop on above-the-fold images; CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) via next/image dimensions and next/font's automatic size-adjust; FID/INP (Interaction to Next Paint) via code splitting, lazy loading, and Concurrent Mode. Use `@vercel/analytics` to report Core Web Vitals from production.
